tested_condition: Global design tokens can be materialized through allowed layout and style files without implementing final pages.
expected_outcome: Reusable color, type, spacing, radius, and responsive tokens are available for Phase3 composition.
actual_outcome: Global CSS tokens were expanded in app/globals.css, and token intent was mirrored in lib/design-tokens.ts for structured reuse in later phases.
passes: Color and surface tokens are centralized.
Typography and spacing scales are defined.
Radius, shadow, and border tokens support framed content treatments.
Responsive and mobile-first container strategies are present.
Focus visibility and contrast intent are explicitly supported.
breakpoint_strategy: 768px for navigation, hero split, and card grid expansion
1080px for wide page container and denser framed section padding
mobile_first_strategy: All core layout primitives default to stacked single-column flow and expand progressively at larger breakpoints.
accessibility_considerations: Readable body line length and line height
High-contrast ink and accent against light surfaces
